items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: I met Art Davis, the great bassist Art Davis

ctx.x: I wonder if you ran into Alvin Queen over in Switzerland.

Oh sure. But Alvin I had met some years earlier. One of my dearest friends and mentors Dr. Jesse Johnson I met Alvin through him. And Dr. Johnson gave me my first Mark VI back in — it’s a 1957 — yeah, my Mark VI. He said, “Look man, it’s time for me to pass this on because you’re going to take this further than I can go with it anymore. And I still have it. And her name is “Baby.” Yeah. But I met him through — I met Alvin through Dr. Johnson, I met Art Davis, the great bassist Art Davis, I met Stanley Cowell…
I’m not sure how to phrase this question but due to your study in psychology do you think that you play to the audience or to an audience member more than other musicians?
